notes.title: New Day, New Update!
notes.content:
New Tutorials: We’ve added helpful tutorials to guide you through your journey. 

 Faster Movement: Your character’s speed has been increased, so you can now move around much faster!

 Energy Efficiency: Serving customers will now consume 4 times less energy, making it easier to keep things running smoothly.

 Bug Fixes: We've resolved the issue with icons appearing and disappearing when using a gamepad to place equipment or furniture.

 Adjusted Mafia Debt: The daily debt from the mafia has been balanced for a more manageable experience.

 Bakery Discount: High happiness now rewards you with a discount at the bakery.

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
Tray Handling Made Easier: You can now directly pick up items on your tray while holding it. 

 New Item Interactions: Whether it’s baked goods, plastic cups, or cardboard cups, you can now directly pick them up on your tray from your item box.

 Bug Fixes for a Smoother Experience: We’ve resolved some pesky saving and loading issues that were causing items to detach from trays. Everything will stay securely in place now. We've also resolved an issue which caused wrong type of grinder to initialize.

 Intuitive Cafe Setup in Progress: We’re working on a new, more intuitive system for setting up your cafe.

notes.title: New Bug Fixes and Features!
notes.content:
Muffin Collision Bug Fixed: No more issues with muffins getting stuck!

 Bulk Buying at the Bakery: Now you can buy in larger quantities with ease.

 Price Labels Added: Clear price displays for all bakery items.

 Improved Clock Text: The clock now looks cleaner and easier to read.

 No More Wasted Cups: Server employees will no longer waste empty cups.

notes.title: Hotfixes for the Latest Update!
notes.content:
Info Prompts for New Users: Added helpful info prompts to guide new users.

 Server Employee Fixes: Resolved critical bugs affecting server employees, improving their functionality and reliability.

 UI Navigation Improvements: Fixed various issues with UI navigation to make the interface more intuitive.

 Localization Updates: Corrected several localization errors for a more accurate experience across regions.

notes.title: Quality Of Life Update!
notes.content:
Smarter NPCs: We've improved NPC AI for better pathfinding behavior, making them more realistic in the game world.

 Auto Pay Bills & Debts: You can now toggle the option to automatically pay your bills and debts directly from the settings.

 Control In-Game Icons: You now have the ability to toggle icons on or off with a single click, giving you more control over your game interface.

 New Customers Timing: New customers will no longer arrive after 22:00, allowing for more balanced gameplay during late hours.

 Bug Fix - Paying Bills: We've fixed the bug where paying bills didn't affect your in-game money, so your finances will now be updated correctly.

 Enhanced Tray Interaction: You can now pick up the tray and directly fill it up by interacting with the item box, streamlining your gameplay.

 Starting Inventory Update: You now begin with some essential items already in your inventory, so you can jump right into the action.

 Increased Starting Money: You’ll now start with 10,000 money, up from 2,000, giving you a better financial head start.

 Master Audio Settings: You can now manage weather audio separately through the master audio settings, giving you more control over the in-game sound experience.

 Fixed User Interface Bugs: We've resolved several UI bugs to make your interface more smooth and responsive, ensuring a better overall experience.

 Fixed Highlight Shader Issues: We’ve resolved some issues with highlight shaders improving visual clarity.


Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us as we continue to improve the game. We’re currently working on a more coherent tutorial to help new players navigate the game and get the most out of their experience. If you have any more suggestions or thoughts, feel free to share them.

notes.title: New Features Added!
notes.content:
New Tutorial Layouts: We've introduced some helpful tutorial layouts to guide you in managing your coffee shop with ease. 

 Nightclub Barista: Now, you can buy soft drinks to quickly boost your happiness.


We hope these additions help you create the ultimate coffee shop experience. Enjoy the update!
